review_notes.crypto-bigint: The OS host API exposes real secret-key signing. The reviewed 0.5.5 Limb::sbb uses widened wrapping subtraction, predating the newer overflowing_sub regression. k256/p256 signing uses custom multiplication/reduction and fixed inversion routines; the reviewed zero-count/division calls process public curve parameters or public recovery data. UintRef and BoxedMontyForm are absent. This is a source- and compiler-bound applicability disposition, NOT a proof of constant-time generated code, a blanket public-input claim, or approval for other consumers/targets.
review_notes.ruzstd: All OS profiling constructors converge on zksync_os_runner. ProfilingSymbols rejects compressed ELF sections by metadata before decoding and gives the upstream profiler only a bounded, private, readonly validated snapshot. Therefore the reachable OS profiling path does not enter the vulnerable decoder, even if the original input path is replaced. The dependency itself remains affected; using it outside this guarded path requires new review.
review_notes.quick-xml: The pinned inferno dependency is used by the OS only to render collected flamegraph lines as SVG; the reviewed OS entrypoint does not accept an XML document for parsing. This narrows the previous global exception to this exact source/graph.
